title: Hospital on-call rota: a coverage check that isn't safe under concurrency
name: On-call rota cover

questions.prompt: Last night the ICU night shift ended up with nobody on call for 40 minutes. Both doctors on the rota had tapped 'come off call' in the app within a second of each other, and both got a success message. The rule that a shift always keeps at least one doctor on call works fine when we test it by hand. Fix rota.ts so the tests pass.
